limitations.text: E2 used five records per dataset for the real acceptance runs.
FUNSD OCR CER/WER were high under the documented deterministic metric.
DocLayNet layout precision and F1 were low despite high mean IoU on matched regions.
57 of 100 DocVQA questions were not answer-indexable under the existing pipeline.
The E3 run recorded 1 document-level failure(s), including the unchanged 25 MB upload-limit failure.
Retrieval metrics are conditional on the 43 answer-indexable/scorable questions.
Hybrid+reranker total latency was substantially higher than Hybrid total latency.
E4 completion was extremely low in the CPU-mode local Ollama environment because generation timed out frequently.

limitations.source: E4 answers and E4.1 diagnostic design
limitations.text: E4 ANLS/EM results have a response-format mismatch concern because the production answer is evidence-first rather than a short answer.
E4 citation rates have tiny denominators and must not be presented as generic citation accuracy.
E4.1 did not enter its measured question loop; extended diagnostic metrics are BLOCKED/NOT_MEASURED, not zero.
No generic total-system accuracy is calculated because OCR, layout, retrieval, RAG completion, and answer metrics measure different tasks.
